title: Refined Inference for Asymptotically Linear Estimators with Non-Negligible Second-Order Remainders
summary: Asymptotically linear estimators in semiparametric models are usually studied through a von Mises expansion in which first-order inference is based on the influence-function variance. This reduction is valid only when the second-order remainder is negligible not only in probability but also in variance, a requirement not implied by the usual product-rate conditions ensuring asymptotic linearity.
